scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The lamp readings
scenes.caption: Aditi brings fictional lamp times into the Decision Lab. The supplied readings are 6, 8, 10, 12 and 44 seconds. Vihaan places every value on a dot plot before choosing a representative summary.
scenes.speech: Aditi brings fictional lamp times into the Decision Lab. The supplied readings are 6, 8, 10, 12 and 44 seconds. Vihaan places every value on a dot plot before choosing a representative summary.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A distant point
scenes.caption: The reading at 44 stretches the horizontal scale. It might record a genuinely slow lamp or a recording problem. Its distance raises a question without establishing which explanation is correct.
scenes.speech: The reading at 44 stretches the horizontal scale. It might record a genuinely slow lamp or a recording problem. Its distance raises a question without establishing which explanation is correct.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Two markers separate
scenes.caption: The total is 80 seconds, giving a mean of 16. The middle sorted reading gives a median of 10. Aditi moves both markers onto the plot so their different answers can be explained from the same list of measurements.
scenes.speech: The total is 80 seconds, giving a mean of 16. The middle sorted reading gives a median of 10. Aditi moves both markers onto the plot so their different answers can be explained from the same list of measurements.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Check the actual list
scenes.caption: Choose a headline that states the median and the wide spread while retaining the unusual observation for checking. Vihaan rejects quietly deleting the largest reading simply to make the batch appear faster. A source check must come before that decision.
scenes.speech: Choose a headline that states the median and the wide spread while retaining the unusual observation for checking. Vihaan rejects quietly deleting the largest reading simply to make the batch appear faster. A source check must come before that decision.
scenes.dialogue: Keep the reason in the record.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A labelled comparison
scenes.caption: With 44 included, the range is 38 seconds. Without that questioned reading, the remaining mean and median are both 9 and the range is 6. This comparison measures sensitivity; it supplies no permission to replace the original evidence silently.
scenes.speech: With 44 included, the range is 38 seconds. Without that questioned reading, the remaining mean and median are both 9 and the range is 6. This comparison measures sensitivity; it supplies no permission to replace the original evidence silently.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: An honest summary note
scenes.caption: Their notebook retains the full list, both calculations and a request to inspect the original timer record. If the reading is verified, the slow lamp needs explanation. If corrected, the revision should preserve its source and reason for future readers.
